review_candidates.description: Bristol Infrastructure Full Time, Part Time, Permanent We’re looking for an experienced, proactive and commercially minded Associate or Principal Infrastructure Engineer to lead and grow our Civils Infrastructure team in Bristol. In this key role, you’ll take the technical and operational lead for civil infrastructure delivery across the region, delivering high-quality highway and drainage engineering for private sector development schemes while building strong client relationships and supporting Pegasus Group’s continued growth. What You Will Do Team leadership and management You’ll lead, mentor and manage a small, dedicated team of engineers and technicians in our Bristol office, creating an environment where people can do their best work and continue to develop. You’ll oversee resources, prioritise workloads and support the team’s operational performance, while providing line management, performance support and structured career development. You’ll also help maintain high standards across technical outputs, promoting quality assurance and supporting compliance with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 requirements. Client and commercial management You’ll be a key local point of contact for clients, local authorities and internal multidisciplinary teams, building trusted relationships and supporting successful project delivery. You’ll prepare, review and approve fee proposals and tender submissions, while maintaining strong financial control across project profitability, invoicing and budget tracking. You’ll also play an active role in business development, helping to secure repeat work and identify opportunities to collaborate across Pegasus Group’s wider growth sectors. Technical delivery and direction You’ll take an independent, holistic lead role on complex civil infrastructure projects, guiding work from pre-planning strategy through to detailed design and construction. This will include leading the production and checking of adoptable and private highway designs, including Section 38 and Section 278 schemes, alongside drainage systems under Section 104. You’ll work closely with our Environmental Engineering team on flood risk assessments, surface water drainage strategies and sustainable drainage systems, while overseeing technical submissions for planning, legal consents, adoptions and technical approvals. Professional standards and strategy You’ll work with a high level of autonomy, using your judgement to resolve complex engineering and consent matters while collaborating with Directors on major fee proposals or particularly complex projects. You’ll also support cross-team knowledge sharing and act as a trusted technical authority, providing guidance and sounding-board support for colleagues across the business. What Are We Looking For. Education - BEng/MEng in Civil Engineering (or equivalent relevant degree). Professional Status - Chartered (CEng) or Incorporated (IEng) status with ICE, CIWEM, or relevant body (desirable for Principal, mandatory/ expected for Associate). Experience - 6+ years (Principal) or 8+ years (Associate) post-graduate experience within UK consultancy/private sector development infrastructure. Sector Requirement - essential experience in residential design (site layout, adoptions, and statutory approvals). Design Knowledge - expertise in UK highways & drainage standards (DMRB, Manual for Streets, CIRIA SuDS Manual, Sewerage Sector Guidance, LLFA guidelines). Statutory Agreements - thorough expertise in Section 38, 278, and 104 legal agreements and technical approvals. Software Familiarity - working knowledge of AutoCAD, 3D modelling (Site3D/Civil 3D), and hydraulic modelling software (Causeway Flow/MicroDrainage). Driving Licence - full UK driving licence. What are the benefits to you? We offer an excellent remuneration and overall benefits package when you join Pegasus Group, which you can view here www.pegasusgroup.co.uk/careers/ We are committed to helping you reach your full potential and support with a range of training and development initiatives throughout your whole career. About Us. We are a dynamic development consultancy that thrives on innovation. Our passion lies in crafting stunning spaces that enrich both the built and natural environment, ultimately impacting people's lives for the better. With expertise spanning various sectors such as residential, health, education, retail, energy, leisure, and employment, we specialise in delivering forward-thinking and sustainable solutions tailored to the demands and possibilities of the 21st century. Diversity, Inclusion and Recognition. Since 2003, Pegasus Group has consistently grown, earning a reputation for excellence and delivery in the market. Our success is attributed to the commitment and dedication of our talented people across our 15 offices. Our staff are the cornerstone of our achievements, playing a pivotal role in our company's success. We prioritise valuing and empowering our team, fostering a culture of inclusion, and belonging. At Pegasus Group, we emphasise caring for each other, our communities, and our clients. Every individual is encouraged to bring their authentic, best self to work every day. How To Apply To apply, please submit your application by clicking ‘Apply’ Make sure to include a copy of your most up to date CV. If you experience any technical issues on the application form or any queries, please email recruitment@pegasusgroup.co.uk

review_candidates.title: Systems Specialist
review_candidates.description: Systems Specialist (Administrator/Engineer/Technician) Beaumont, TX | Travel Required (50–90% - Locally in SETX – No overnights) Overview Support and maintain industrial systems, including datacenter platforms, hypervisors, networking systems, DCS/PLC systems, and/or Windows/Linux server environments. Participate in system design, installation, upgrades, troubleshooting, and customer support across multiple industries/platforms. We are considering both experienced and early career levels. The administrator level is expected to lead activities and play a more active role in project/service management, design, and documentation. The technician level is expected to execute assigned project and maintenance tasks such as software installations and system patching. Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain Windows/Linux Servers (AD, DNS, RDS, IIS), Hypervisor environments, container orchestrators, managed switches, firewalls, CI/CD infrastructure, and/or VPS/cloud infrastructure. Design, install, and document software, network, and/or server infrastructure. Troubleshoot/diagnose systems of all kinds when they are not functioning properly including:, servers, networks, PLC/SCADA/DCS systems, software environments,etc. Perform system upgrades, patching, and preventative maintenance. Lead or support FAT/SAT testing, field cabinet testing, and commissioning. Deploy, monitor, and maintain software automation pipelines. Provide on-site and remote customer support and troubleshooting. Respond to service requests, create service tickets, document troubleshooting/resolutions. Participate in emergency on-call rotation Collaborate with project teams on system integration and infrastructure setup Assist with FEED & sales activities such as site walkdowns, system design, estimating as needed. Qualifications AS/BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or IT-related field 0–5 yr (technician) 5-10+ yr (administrator) experience in IT/OT or control/automation systems. Proficiency with networking, Virtualization, Windows administration, and control systems (DeltaV Strongly Preferred) Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills Ability to travel extensively (locally) and lift up to 60 lbs Preferred Skills Experience with firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet), wireless Aps, managed switches. Familiarity with Cisco/Emerson switches, Dell hardware, and industrial protocols (OPC, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, etc.) Some familiarity with software system maintenance/deployment is a plus. Control system programming, system integration, and industrial communication Familiarity with PLCs, SCADA, MES, and data historians (e.g., OSI PI, IP.21, DataParc)
